heading: INT. UNDERGROUND PARKING GARAGE - SPEED CLIMBING WALL - NIGHT

units.text: INT. UNDERGROUND PARKING GARAGE - SPEED CLIMBING WALL - NIGHT
A concrete bunker converted to a training gym.
A forty-foot climbing wall bristling with colored holds, chalk dust drifting like smoke.
A battered boombox sits on a plastic crate, cassette tape turning.
SOLENE DUBOIS (20s, tank top, taped fingers, chalk bag on her hip) stands at the base of the wall.
She rolls her neck, shakes out her arms, then bends and kisses the knuckles of each hand.
A stopwatch hangs from her wrist.
Beside the wall a laminated sign reads: RECORD 5.48.
She presses START on the stopwatch and slaps the first hold.
Her body flows up the wall, forearms flexing, toes smearing on the foot chips, her left hand swatting a hold while her right hand already reaches for the next.
At the midpoint, she swings her weight out, catches a sloper with her fingertips, and one of her feet slips.

She hangs by one hand for a half-second, her whole body swinging out over the mat, and then her foot finds the chip again and she surges upward, past the crux, past the red hold, past the yellow, and slaps the top button.
Lands in a crouch on the mat.
She sits down hard on the mat, breath ragged, forehead against her knees.
The boombox cassette clicks and flips to the B side.
A man's voice, warm, gravelly, slightly distorted, starts up from the speakers.

Solene, it's you. I know you're going to listen to this at two in the morning because you never sleep before a final. I want you to remember the third hold from the top. You always rush it. Breathe there. One breath. The wall will wait for you.
units.name: SOLENE

units.text: She looks at the boombox, then up at the wall.
And remember. You are not climbing against the clock. You are climbing against yesterday's Solene. She was good. Be better.
units.name: SOLENE

units.text: Solene wipes her eyes with a chalky wrist, leaving a white streak across her cheek.
She reaches the midpoint, reaches the sloper, and this time doesn't slip.
At the third hold from the top, she pauses.
Then she surges up and slaps the button.
Her mouth cracks into a grin.
She pumps one fist in the empty air, then another.
She turns to the boombox and lifts it from the crate, clutching it against her chest as the tape spools slowly backward.
